name: OctoFarm
description: The retained OctoFarm source supports GitHub release discovery and version notification. Its self-update implementation and artifact-authentication policy remain unresolved.
limitations: Newly recovered default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification.

The reviewed service does not establish a self-update executor, reset policy, PM2 integration, or release artifact verification; other files/dependencies were not treated as evidence for those claims.
